verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows GitHub Copilot code review (github-docs-25), CI/CD via Actions (github-docs-38), and a marketplace of third-party integrations (github-intdir-1, github-intdir-7), but nothing explicitly describes large-diff handling in the PR review screen or third-party code-quality/coverage reports rendered inline as review annotations. missing for 10: documentation of large-diff review UX (e.g. diff pagination, file-by-file review tools), evidence of third-party check results (e.g. code coverage, linting, SAST) surfaced directly in the Files Changed/review screen via the Checks API.
